initial.name: im_send
initial.description: Send a message or deliver a file to a chat app chat without waiting for someone to write first. You can reach the chats whose messages come to you and every chat on a connection you own. Replies go to the Bot assigned to that chat.

text.description: Plain text or Markdown, up to 4000 characters. Required when files are omitted

chat.description: Chat name or its listed key. Omit it to use your one own chat. If a name is shared, use the name with its key

files.description: Feishu only. Up to 5 paths inside your working folder, each up to 30 MiB, sent in order after any text
